question: The value of (256)⁰.¹⁶ times (256)⁰.⁰⁹ is:
solution:
**Given:**

(256)⁰.¹⁶ times (256)⁰.⁰⁹

**Formula used:**

(a^m times a^n) = am⁺ⁿ

**Calculation:**

(256)⁰.¹⁶ times (256)⁰.⁰⁹

⇒ (256)⁰.¹⁶⁺⁰.⁰⁹

⇒ (256)⁰.²⁵

⇒ (256¹/⁴)

⇒ 4

**∴ The value of (256)⁰.¹⁶ times (256)⁰.⁰⁹ is 4.**
